decisions.meaning: Thread 5 entry services retrace-driven controller reads and queued EEPROM operations.
Initializes controller status and mask; returns -1 for any connected responsive controller, otherwise mask. Preserve return convention.
Retrieves completed controller read data and conditionally forwards buttons or error substitutes for connected ports.
Drains buffered current/previous button samples through func_8006E418 up to a captured producer index.
Marks a selected 0x14-byte piece-operation slot active, sets its index and clears its payload; does not increment the active count.
Finds the first inactive slot among 64 in the current player context, increments active count and initializes it; logs and returns 64 if full. Not a FIFO or heap allocation.
Advances a due piece operation according to its flags, updates board/operation state and returns the next delay. Handles both action and subsequent movement/resolution.

Rotates the vector referenced by args 3/4/5 in place, applying Z-X-Y axis rotations in that order. Angle arguments 0/1/2 are Y/X/Z in degrees. Calls SDK trigonometry but is a separate game-side wrapper used for lighting.

Rotates the vector referenced by args 3/4/5 in place, applying Y-X-Z axis rotations in that order. Angle arguments 0/1/2 are Y/X/Z in degrees. Calls SDK trigonometry but is a separate game-side wrapper used for lighting.

Transforms all four vector components in place with out[i] = sum(matrix[j][i] * in[j]); saves all outputs before overwriting input, does not divide by w. Used for positions (w=1) and up direction (w=0) in reflection look-at setup.
Builds 16x16 records of base position and radial layer step by fixed-point interpolation of a coordinate table, with optional axis scaling and multiplayer base-position offset.
Builds a 16x16 inward radial normal table and two 15-vector directional tables from the board grid, normalized to magnitude 120 with renderer coordinate order.

Fills available slots up to two tracked graphics tasks, captures update count, builds each frame, finalizes/caches Fast3D task data and then sends the tasks to the scheduler. Counters track built/unconsumed completions; preserve nonblocking send and unchecked result.
Per-build dispatcher: drains input, initializes graphics and button state, selects priority state/screen branches or gameplay update/render, and adds gameplay fades. Not a single simulation tick.
Selects frame display-list/vertex storage, initializes segment commands, clears depth-buffer storage and selects the framebuffer for drawing. Also rerun after graphics-buffer repartitioning.

Initializes, updates and draws the pause menu and dispatches its AUDIO/EXIT subordinate flows; consumes input edges from the controller that opened it and requests animated close before normal resume.
Copies 320x240 u16 pixels from the previous frame record framebuffer into the shared screen-image buffer. Does not choose the VI displayed buffer or synchronize graphics itself.
Advances shared screen counters, opacity/color interpolation and transition timers on scheduler VIDEO_MSG. One countdown precedes the global freeze gate; preserve this ordering.

Initializes, updates and draws the shared audio settings screen: balance, AUTO/RANDOM/CHOOSE music mode and immediate song selection. Uses combined controller input; closing from pause clears the pause selection and resumes gameplay.
Computes the save-image checksum from 127 native big-endian u32 words: seed 0x25, rotate left by three and add each word modulo 2^32. Excludes the trailing checksum word.
Refreshes the save image trailing checksum and requests an EEPROM write of changed blocks. Used by settings and other save-data mutations; not a synchronous storage-completion guarantee.

Marks differing 8-byte blocks in a 512-byte buffer against the RAM shadow, copies the buffer into that shadow and, when EEPROM is detected, requests a type-1 write through a nonblocking message send. Worker uses the supplied pointer; preserve shared request state and unchecked send result.

Updates and draws four five-entry ranked record pages, highlights the inserted row, handles combined-controller navigation and timed or manual dismissal. Shared by pause EXIT and other menu/results paths; not a save confirmation.

Inserts a qualifying name/result into a mode-specific five-entry ranked table, shifts lower ranks and records the highlight index. Higher scores win except mode 4 where lower times win; ties insert before existing equals. Requests persistence when the save gate is enabled; fourth parameter unused.

Encodes eight player-name character slots into six bytes of six-bit codes. Character offset is 0x20; NUL or underscore code 0x3F pads the remaining slots. Reads all eight source bytes, with no arbitrary-text validation.
Decodes six packed player-name bytes to exactly eight character slots, translating code 0x3F to NUL. Does not append a ninth-byte terminator or propagate the first padding code across later slots.

scope: Cumulative twenty-six global C function names. Batch 009 names the records menu, ranked insertion and player-name encoding pair. Only identifier tokens in main.c change; all types, signatures, comments, expressions and formatting remain intact.
validation: Run identifier_renames.py, matchdiff.sh and full-ROM cmp; evidence stored separately.
